comparisons.name: window-light
comparisons.description: The whole Voice Memos capture, Aqua: the window with its shadow, as the demo opens. Whole crop: the bars are an invented envelope, the text is set in the fallback font and the glyphs are original drawings.

comparisons.name: window-layout-light
comparisons.description: The same with the text, the stand-in glyphs and the bars masked: the title, the Trim glyph, the bars of the waveform and of the overview (sample data: the capture's recording is not reproduced), the ruler's and the overview's labels, the timer, the two skip glyphs and the label of Done. Scores the frame and its shadow, the translucent toolbar over black with its button's bezel, the waveform panel, the playhead, the ruler's ticks, the overview's strip and handle, the bottom bar, the record pill with its pause mark, the play triangle and the Done pill, Aqua.

comparisons.name: window-dark
comparisons.description: The whole Voice Memos capture, Dark Aqua: another recording, 3.065 s long, under the dark toolbar. Whole crop, as window-light.

comparisons.name: window-layout-dark
comparisons.description: As window-dark with the same text, glyphs and bars masked as window-layout-light: the frame and its shadow, the dark translucent toolbar, and the content, which is the same in both appearances but for the ruler, 3 pt further right, and the overview's handle, 2 pt further left, Dark Aqua.

comparisons.name: done-shows-library
comparisons.description: Done, clicked in the window as it opens: the list of recordings takes the leading 251 pt as a sidebar, with the round record button at its foot, the player keeps its black content beside it, and the bottom bar has lost the Done pill. No screenshot shows this view; the colours are the tokens' (the sidebar's fill is the Catalyst chrome's, measured on News).

pixels.note: the sidebar's fill beside the record button: --mac-catalyst-chrome-sidebar-fill, Aqua (measured on News); the view itself is inferred
the record button's disc, centred in the sidebar 36 pt above the window's bottom edge: --mac-voice-memos-record (measured on the pause mark); the button is inferred
the player's content under the toolbar, beside the sidebar: --mac-voice-memos-background (measured)
the bottom bar where the Done pill stood: the bar's gradient half way down, #191919 to #0d0d0d (measured: #131313 @ 1600,1262)

comparisons.name: play-shows-pause
comparisons.description: The play button, clicked in the list view after the fourth recording (138 s long, so it is still playing when the capture is taken) is chosen: the triangle gives way to the two bars of the pause mark. No screenshot shows playback.

pixels.note: the pause mark's first bar, 6.5 pt wide from 3 pt into the glyph's 25 pt box: --mac-voice-memos-transport (measured on the play triangle); the pause mark is inferred
the gap between the two bars, where the triangle was solid: the bar's gradient half way down (measured: #131313 @ 1600,1262)
